description_en: Synchronizes user mapping between different third-party systems
description_zh: 调用本接口，可实现将人员信息在不同的三方系统中进行同步映射
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen sync-third-user-mapping --user-id user_1234 --third-user-id third_user_2234 --third-channel-type weCom --status 1 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SyncThirdUserMapping

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Business Travel user ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID in the target mapping system
parameters.help_zh: 映射目标系统中人员 ID
parameters.name: third_user_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the mapping is valid
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
When appending this parameter, use `corp_token=value` instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 `corp_token=value` 代替
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace ID of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
